data.title: Sprint Review and Daily Scrum are reports in the catalogue, not commands of their own
data.why: Both are folds over what the journal already holds, and the catalogue is where an agent reading schema --json looks for folds; every report there has --json, --html and a perf case. The review adds the decisions recorded during the sprint, the shared context a stakeholder missed.
data.rejected: Top-level kadence review / kadence daily: two more commands in --help for what report already names
